title: Every friendly, unmet NPC I later recruited (Vell, Tamsin, Lys) offered an 'attack X with short sword' menu option before a single line of dialogue, phrased identically to genuinely hostile monster attacks; the same option persisted for Brother Osk even after dozens of turns as a loyal party member.
where: The Last Light Inn, 'attack Vell with short sword'; Gray Chapel (late game), 'attack Brother Osk with short sword'
